remarks: Located within walking distance to the center and town parks, you'll have easy access to all Wilton has to offer. This 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home offers an effortless single-floor living experience, ideal for those who value convenience and comfort. Step inside to discover a freshly painted interior complemented by brand-new carpeting that adds a touch of warmth to every corner. The kitchen opens to the backyard, perfect for sipping your morning coffee or unwinding after a long day. One of the features of this home is the in-unit washer and dryer, ensuring that laundry day is a breeze. You'll also enjoy the convenience of a 1-car garage, complete with a storage room that's perfect for seasonal items or a personal workshop. Plus, you can take advantage of the community pool, providing a perfect retreat during the warm summer months.
